description: Assembly Minority Leader Ed Ra (R-Franklin Square) hosted his eighth annual “There Ought to Be a Law” ceremony on Monday, June 22 at Mineola High School, where he recognized 30 semi-finalists selected from 553 entries submitted by fifth-grade students across nine local schools. The annual contest invites students to think critically about ideas they think might make good laws. This year’s winning proposal was submitted by Gabriella Rodia of Polk Street School.
